positions.name: OwnedVersusRentedIntelligence
positions.frame: What separates intelligence an individual owns from intelligence they rent, and which layer of the stack is the thing worth keeping?
positions.why: Both segments draw the same owned/rented line in matched antithetical clauses. src-1 contrasts owned and rented intelligence directly. src-2 names the layers: substrate on one side, perspective on the other. The register and style reads show the same crystallized maxim form in both, so one frame covers them. No tension sits inside the set. The second segment sharpens the first by saying what is rented and what is kept. The graph is empty, so there is nothing to attach to and no lineage to type.
